THE TEMPLATE

One data file, every shape of journey.

1 · Add the days

Duplicate a journey inside assets/journeys.js. Every day gets its own title and journal text, whether you travel or stay put.

2 · Add photographs

Put web-sized images in assets/photos, or paste any public image URL. Link every photo to a day and add GPS when you have it.

3 · Let metadata help

Phone photos may already contain time and GPS data. Captions, OCR text, and tags can be imported, inferred and then reviewed.

4 · Publish anywhere

The finished site is static. It can live here, on GitHub Pages, or behind a custom domain without changing the journey format.

Photo storage: start with optimized WebP/AVIF files in the project. If the archive becomes large, keep the same day data and switch src values to Cloudinary or object-storage URLs.
